dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: I'm the owner of the Weary Inn, and I also run a food stall at the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Speaking of this place, I even stayed here for free back when I was a contestant. Who'd have thought I'd be the one in charge now, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Do you know anyone who's taken part in the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame?

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: If you did, that would make things a lot easier. You could stay with them, and you'd dine and bunk on the house — all you can eat, too!
